scope: Windows native game-local V95 offline translation

evidence_levels.E0: Documented format or source; not proven working
evidence_levels.E2: Original Windows V95 binary built and model/integrity tests passed
evidence_levels.E3: Owner's real game visibly translated, including choices and native speaker
evidence_levels.E4: Owner's game moved to another clean Windows machine and used offline

source_notes: Historical TX354 reported 0 of 52 physical Windows10 scenarios at its own date; this is not a claim that physical tests could never be completed later.
17 menu families are not 17 TX207 resource profiles and not five launcher variants.
The TX775 V95 package applies only to MV/MZ and is not part of unified R1 detector EXE.
Every adaptation must be validated before install and revert correctly without touching unrelated data.
